p: Beulah Street is a pedestrianised shopping street right in the middle of Harrogate, a couple of minutes from the railway and bus stations, so you can come here without worrying about parking. This is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so the kids will need to be elsewhere.

Harrogate is a proper spa town, and once you've done the machines it's worth having a wander. The Stray, a big sweep of open grassland, wraps round the centre. Valley Gardens is lovely in summer, the Royal Pump Room Museum tells the story of the sulphur springs, and if you've never queued for Bettys Café Tea Rooms, now's your chance. The Turkish Baths are there if you fancy something very different.
